steps.what: Open efficient routes for delivering goods
Follow the route and change it for the goods

tasks.design: A route already stored in {OPS_SYSTEM} is opened. It is the stop order someone entered, not a new plan made by the screen. The courier follows it and changes it when the goods, the access, or a new stop require a change. The screen does not send the courier.
tasks.previous_blocker: The courier sketched the round on paper each morning.
tasks.enabler_now: The stop order is already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Following the round, and changing it on the day, stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier sees the road and the goods.

ambition.what: A stored route is ready before departure, and the courier still decides any change.

tasks.altitude: The courier accepts or changes the route before setting off.

evidence.claim: A stop order that is already stored can be shown. Choosing to follow or change it stays with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a round is about to start and ends when the courier has followed it or recorded a change.
A route row is an ordered list of stops entered by a person. The screen does not reorder it.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the stored order cannot be followed as written.
research_questions: Which routes were followed as stored, and which the courier changed?

already_counted.description: The trip or the note is already in the courier's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened stop when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the stored order cannot be followed. High: the order is usable and the courier still travels and changes what the day requires. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the routine maintenance list for delivery vehicles
Perform routine maintenance, monitoring fluid levels and replenishing fuel

tasks.design: The routine maintenance list for the delivery vehicle is opened from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier performs the check, monitoring fluid levels and replenishing fuel. The list does not measure a level or add fuel.
tasks.previous_blocker: The due checks were a card in the vehicle.
tasks.enabler_now: The due list is stored against the vehicle.
tasks.still_hard: Looking at the levels and adding fuel stay with the courier.
tasks.altitude: The maintenance work does not change. The due list is only the reminder.

evidence.claim: A stored due list can name the checks. Monitoring levels and adding fuel stay with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a vehicle is due a routine check and ends when the courier has done the check or noted what was not done.
A due row has vehicle id and check name, maintained by the fleet owner. The level the courier saw is what they write.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the vehicle needs more than the routine list.
research_questions: Which checks were done, and which the courier noted as not done?

already_counted.description: The trip or the note is already in the courier's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened stop when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the vehicle needs work the list does not name. High: the list is the reminder and the courier still checks and refuels. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the stop that needs a signature or a payment
Obtain signatures and payments from recipients
Arrange for recipients to make payments later

tasks.design: A stop that requires a signature or a payment is opened from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier obtains the signature and the payment from the recipient, or arranges for the recipient to pay later. {BANK} stores only the amount the courier entered. The screen does not take the money.
tasks.previous_blocker: The amount due was a figure on the paper stop.
tasks.enabler_now: The amount due is on the stop.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the person, taking the money, and agreeing a later payment stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier sees the note and the person.

ambition.what: The amount due is on the stop at the door, and the courier still takes it or arranges it.

tasks.altitude: The courier takes or arranges the payment. The screen does not.

evidence.claim: An amount due can be shown on a stop. Taking a signature or a payment stays with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a stop requires a signature or a payment and ends when the courier has taken it, arranged it, or refused.
A stop row has stop id and amount due, entered before the run. The amount taken is what the courier entered. A blank amount is not collected.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the recipient will not pay or sign.
research_questions: Which stops were signed and paid, and which were arranged or refused?

already_counted.description: The trip or the note is already in the courier's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened stop when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The stop id, the signature, and the amount taken

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the recipient will not sign or pay. High: the amount is on the stop and the courier still collects or arranges. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show which goods move to which vehicle
Unload goods from large trucks onto smaller delivery vehicles

tasks.design: Which goods move to which vehicle is shown from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier unloads the goods from large trucks and loads them onto smaller delivery vehicles. The list does not lift the goods.
tasks.previous_blocker: The split was shouted across the yard.
tasks.enabler_now: The move list names the vehicle for each item.
tasks.still_hard: The lifting stays with the courier.
tasks.altitude: The physical move does not change.

evidence.claim: A stored move list can name the destination vehicle. Unloading and loading stay with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a large truck is being broken down and ends when the goods are on the smaller vehicles.
A move row has item id and destination vehicle, entered by the dispatcher.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often a good has no destination vehicle.
research_questions: Which goods were moved, and which had no vehicle?

already_counted.description: The trip or the note is already in the courier's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened stop when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: goods have no destination vehicle. High: the list names the vehicle and the lifting remains. The range stays under the net.
